propositions: T3 and T10 criteria must be promoted from non-blocking to blocking with a conservative 0.90 block_threshold to filter actionable findings
T10 DET overlay gate must trigger on infra/IaC vocabulary (terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, IAM, EC2, S3, GitHub Actions workflows) to pre-gate findings before LLM routing

T10 severity guidance must restrict major-class designation to only destructive apply, wildcard-overbroad grants, plaintext secrets, and unauthenticated internet-reachable services so lesser findings cannot cross the 0.90 priority threshold
Pinned test assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py and test_impact_model_versioning.py must be updated to reflect T3 and T10 as approved blocking criteria
Findings at priority ≥ 0.90 must produce blocking decisions through Pass-3 while findings < 0.90 remain advisory
T10 DetGateRule must fire on infra and GitHub Actions workflow fixtures and skip non-infra plans with proper coverage tracking
